headline: Hidayat Nur Wahid Resigns As Deputy Speaker Of The Indonesian MPR
seoTitle: Hidayat Nur Wahid Resigns As MPR Deputy Speaker
metaDescription: Senior politician Hidayat Nur Wahid has stepped down as Deputy Speaker of the Indonesian MPR, with PKS appointing Sohibul Iman as his replacement.
aiSummaryBullets: Hidayat Nur Wahid officially resigned from his position as Deputy Speaker of the People's Consultative Assembly (MPR) on November 10, 2026.
The Prosperous Justice Party (PKS) has appointed Mohamad Sohibul Iman to serve as the successor for the vacant deputy leadership role.
The party stated that Hidayat Nur Wahid will be reassigned to lead the House of Representatives' Inter-Parliamentary Cooperation Board to focus on diplomatic efforts.
aiContextParagraph: On November 10, 2026, senior politician Hidayat Nur Wahid confirmed his resignation from the position of Deputy Speaker of the People's Consultative Assembly of the Republic of Indonesia (MPR RI). The Prosperous Justice Party (PKS), which he represents, announced that Mohamad Sohibul Iman has been appointed to fill the vacancy. According to PKS Secretary-General Muhammad Kholid, this administrative transition is intended to allow Hidayat Nur Wahid to assume new responsibilities as the Chairman of the Inter-Parliamentary Cooperation Board (BKSAP) of the House of Representatives. In this new capacity, he is expected to prioritize international diplomacy and support initiatives regarding Palestine. While the MPR has confirmed receipt of his formal resignation, the announcement coincided with broader political developments in the country, including reports regarding the status of the Vice President.
whyItIsViral: The event generated significant attention due to the high-profile nature of the political leadership change and its occurrence during a day of major national political developments.
